title: Launch a new campaign
summary: Describe a campaign to the platform's AI agent, review the campaign brief it writes, and save it — the first step of every campaign.
bodyMd:
Launch a New Campaign creates the campaign brief. You describe the campaign in your own words, the platform's AI agent writes the brief from your description and your brand guidelines, and you review it before saving. Allow about 2 minutes.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account.
  • Target audiences and campaign objectives defined under Company Settings → Campaign Settings — see Define target audiences and campaign objectives.
  • Brand guidelines uploaded under Company Settings → Brand / Logo / Guidelines — see Step 5 — Upload your brand, logos and icons. The AI agent uses them when writing the brief.
  • A display type and playlist for each touch-point you want to launch on — see Create a display type and playlist.

Describe the campaign

  1. In the left navigation, select Campaigns.
  2. At the top right, select Launch a New Campaign.
  3. Describe the campaign: the brand or product, who it targets, the scene you want to show, and the displays or touch-points to launch on.

    For example: Launch a campaign for Awesome Bags' new weatherproof handbag, targeting upper class females. Show a lady in a high-end restaurant, raining outside, with the handbag on the table. Launch on the Amazon landscape and Amazon portrait displays.

  4. Wait while the AI agent writes the brief. It draws on your brand guidelines and any industry-specific compliance requirements. The campaign opens on its Campaign Brief tab.

Review and save the campaign brief

  1. Check Campaign Name and Campaign Details. Every field is editable.
  2. If the campaign has a landing page, enter it in Campaign Landing Page URL. Select + Add token to insert a platform token into the URL.
  3. Check Promoted Product(s) and Product SKU(s). Press Enter after each value to add more than 1.
  4. Check Target Audience(s) and Campaign Objective. Both lists come from Campaign Settings.
  5. Under ENABLED TOUCH-POINT(S), turn on each touch-point the campaign runs on, then choose where it plays:
    • Digital Signage → Playlist(s)
    • Store Sites → Mobile Site Template(s)
    • Website → Website pages/sections
  6. Select Update Campaign Brief.
A campaign can be enabled on several playlists at once, for example a landscape and a portrait playlist. When its rules match, the campaign plays on every display in the store that carries one of those playlists.

Verify it worked

The campaign shows Status Not Activated at the top right of the page. It appears in the Campaigns list with its enabled touch-points ticked and its playlists listed. It does not play anywhere until you activate it.
